name: Barbell Bench Press
form_cues: Keep your feet planted firmly on the floor.
Retract your scapula (pinch shoulder blades together).

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
form_cues: Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells until they are level with your chest.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
form_cues: Set the bench to a 30-45 degree angle.
Keep your elbows tucked at a 45-degree angle to protect your shoulders.

name: Machine Converging Chest Press
form_cues: Keep chest up and proud.
Drive elbows across the body for maximum pec contraction.

name: Deficit Push-Up
form_cues: Elevate hands on blocks or dumbbells to increase the stretch at the bottom (science-based).
Keep core tight and maintain a straight line from head to heels.

name: Pec Deck Fly
form_cues: Keep a slight bend in the elbows.
Focus on squeezing your biceps together at the center to fully contract the chest.

name: Pull-Up
form_cues: Start from a dead hang with active shoulders.
Pull your chest to the bar by driving your elbows down and back.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
form_cues: Hinge at the hips until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
Pull the bar towards your belly button, squeezing your shoulder blades.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
form_cues: Keep your back flat and parallel to the floor.
Pull the dumbbell to your hip, not your chest, to target the lats.

name: Lat Pulldown (Neutral Grip)
form_cues: Drive elbows straight down towards your hips.
Avoid leaning back excessively to keep the tension on the lats.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
form_cues: Keep chest glued to the pad to prevent cheating with momentum.
Squeeze shoulder blades together hard at the top.

name: Single-Arm Iliac Cable Pulldown
form_cues: Align the cable path with your lower lat fibers (iliac division).
Pull the elbow tight to your side and pause.
Allow full stretch at the top.

name: Barbell Back Squat
form_cues: Break at hips and knees simultaneously.
Keep chest up and brace core heavily.

name: Barbell Front Squat
form_cues: Keep your elbows pointed up as high as possible.
Maintain a very upright torso throughout the movement.

name: Pendulum Squat
form_cues: Control the eccentric (lowering) phase.
Maximize knee flexion for maximum quad stretch (science-based hypertrophy).

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
form_cues: Keep front foot flat on the ground.
Allow the front knee to track over the toes for maximum quad bias.
Drop straight down rather than leaning back.

name: Leg Extension
form_cues: Pull yourself tightly into the seat using the handles.
Control the weight down, maximizing tension in the lengthened position.

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
form_cues: Push hips back until you feel a deep stretch in the hamstrings.
Keep the bar glued to your legs the entire time.

name: Seated Leg Curl
form_cues: Lean forward slightly to increase the stretch on the hamstrings (science-based).
Control the eccentric phase on the way up.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
form_cues: Brace core and squeeze glutes to protect lower back.
Press the bar straight up, pushing your head through the 'window' at the top.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
form_cues: Keep your back pressed flat against the pad.
Lower the dumbbells until they touch your shoulders, then press up.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
form_cues: Maintain a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the side until they are parallel to the floor.

name: Cross-Body Cable Lateral Raise
form_cues: Set cable at wrist-height to create a constant tension profile (science-based).
Lead with the elbows and drag the cable across your body.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
form_cues: Keep arms slightly bent but locked in position.
Pull out to the sides rather than just backward to isolate the rear delts.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
form_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Avoid swinging your torso to lift the weight.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
form_cues: Set bench to 60 degrees.
Let arms hang straight down to heavily stretch the long head of the bicep.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
form_cues: Face away from the cable machine.
Keep your elbow behind your torso to maximize stretch (science-based).

name: EZ Bar Skullcrusher
form_cues: Lie flat on a bench and lower the bar towards your forehead.
Keep your elbows pointing up and stationary.

name: Cross-Body Cable Tricep Extension (Katana Extension)
form_cues: Cross the cables in front of you.
Keep elbows fixed and extend outward. This aligns perfectly with the tricep fiber direction.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
form_cues: Use a rope or D-handle attachment.
Keep elbows pointing up to maximally stretch the long head of the tricep.

name: Standing Calf Raise
form_cues: Keep your knees straight but not fully locked out.
Lower your heels until you feel a deep stretch, then press up onto your toes.

name: Seated Calf Raise
form_cues: This isolates the soleus muscle underneath the gastrocnemius.
Focus on the deep stretch at the bottom of the movement.

name: Seated Cable Row (V-Bar)
form_cues: Keep your torso relatively upright.
Pull the V-bar to your belly button and squeeze your shoulder blades together.

name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
form_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Press the bar or rope down until your arms are fully locked out.

name: Standard Cable Bicep Curl
form_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use the cable tension for a smooth contraction at the top.

name: Standard Cable Lateral Raise
form_cues: Stand next to the cable tower and pull the cable across your body.
Lead with your elbows to isolate the side deltoid.

name: Lying Dumbbell Leg Curl
form_cues: Place a dumbbell between your feet and lie face down.
Curl the dumbbell towards your glutes while keeping your hips pressed against the floor.

name: Glute Bridge Walkout
form_cues: Start in a glute bridge position.
Slowly walk your feet out away from your body, then walk them back in.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
form_cues: Hold the dumbbell vertically behind your head.
Keep elbows close to your ears to maximize the stretch on the long head of the tricep.

name: Dumbbell Skullcrusher
form_cues: Lie on a bench or the floor.
Lower the dumbbells towards your shoulders, keeping elbows pointed up.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
form_cues: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand on the edge of a step.
Lower your heels for a deep stretch, then press up onto your toes.
